# Substring

Takes part of text, from a start position, of a given length or to the end.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Substring(text, start, [length])
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to take part of. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `start` | number | The position of the first character to take, counted from 0 in UTF-16 code units. A whole number from 0 to the length of text; the length itself gives the empty string. A larger number is a runtime error, as is a negative or fractional one. |
| `length` | number, optional | The number of characters to take, in UTF-16 code units: a whole number of 0 or more, a negative or fractional one being a runtime error. A length that reaches past the end of text takes what is there. When it is left out, or null, the rest of text from start is taken. |

## Returns

String. The part of text that begins at start. Never null.

## Example

`Substring("abcdef", 2, 3)` returns `"cde"`.

`Substring("abcdef", 4)` returns `"ef"`.
